name: Amazon Redshift
summary: Run queries and load Parquet partitions into Amazon Redshift, provisioned or serverless, with COPY from S3. Loads are idempotent by partition and revision (ADR 0012).

auth.label: IAM access key pair (temporary database credentials)
IAM role of the daemon host

settings.name: host
settings.label: Endpoint
settings.help: Cluster endpoint or serverless workgroup endpoint, without the port.

settings.name: db_user
settings.label: Database user for IAM sign-in
settings.help: Only for the two IAM methods.

settings.name: copy_role_arn
settings.label: IAM role for COPY
settings.help: A role attached to the cluster or workgroup that can read the staging bucket.

egress.note: 5439 is the Redshift default; the IAM methods call the Redshift and STS APIs on 443.

operators.summary: Run a SQL query and keep the result as Parquet.
Load Parquet from S3 with COPY, once per partition and revision.

notes: Staging goes through S3; add the Amazon S3 connector's domains to the same egress approval. Redshift reads the staged files itself, so the cluster role, not Ogun, needs access to the bucket.
